title: Buzzy's Random Stuff
description: Buzzy's Random stuff adds some different features to the game with no clear theme or focus. At the moment there isn't much but with future updates I will add more and more to this mod.
body:
Buzzy's Random stuff adds some different features to the game with no clear theme or focus. At the moment there isn't much but with future updates I will add more and more to this mod.

**Features**
# Items
- Football: A non-living entity crafted from 4 leather, 2 white dye, and 2 black dye, which can be kicked around like a real-life football. Its kick distance is dependent on whether you're walking, sprinting, or sneaking, and it kicks in the direction you're looking. To pick it back up, punch it once to "kill" it and it will drop as an item.
- Marshmallow: A food made with water, a slimeball, and sugar. Can be cooked to make a roasted marshmallow and can be crafted into a marshmallow block
- Chocolate Bar: A food made from cocoa beans and sugar. Can be crafted into a block of chocolate
- Graham Cracker: A food made from wheat and sugar.
- S'more: A food made from crafting together the 3 foods listed above.
- Energy Drink: Crafted from 4 blocks of sugar, 2 cocoa beans, a water bucket, and 2 glass bottles. Gives Speed 10 and Jump Boost 2 for 4 seconds.
- Chisel: A tool which is used to turn blocks into their chiselled variant. Simply use it on any block that has a chiselled variant. For example, it will turn Stone Bricks into Chiselled Stone Bricks.
- Hammer: A tool which can unpack blocks that can't be unpacked by crafting or mining them like Nether Quartz, can separate things from blocks like Gold Nuggets from GIlded Blackstone, and can turn blocks into their "cracked" variant if they have one.
- Ice Shard: Equal to 1/9 of an ice block, can be obtained by hammering one, and can be crafted into an ice block.
Spray Bottle: When filled with water, oxidises unwaxed copper blocks by one level when used.
- Red Nether Brick: 4 of them are crafted like how the Red Nether Bricks block is in vanilla, and the block is now crafted with 4 of these.
- Rake: A tiered tool which tills a 3x3 area of dirt at once.
# Blocks
- Block of Chocolate: A decorative block crafted from 9 chocolate bars. Can also be crafted back into 9 cholocate bars
- Marshmallow Block: A block made from 9 marshmallows, same as chocolate. In the future I plan to make this block cushion all fall damage
- Block of Sugar: A block crafted with 9 sugar
- Support Beam: A decorative block which comes in all wood and brick types
- Purple Petals: A plant found in Grape Savannas. Similar to Pink Petals, up to 4 can be placed in one block space and they can be duplicated with bone meal.
- Tombstone: A block found above ground in cemetery biomes, marking each grave.
- Bone Litter: A block found buried in graves in cemetery biomes. Can only be obtained with Silk Touch, otherwise 2 bones are dropped instead.
- Wall Lantern: A version of the lantern that can hang on walls, crafted with any support beam and a lantern. All regular lantern variants have a wall lantern as well.
- Railing: A wooden or brick diagonal stacking block which works as a diagonal fence. They seamlessly connect to each other and regular fences.
- Railing Corner: A railing that turns. Comes in right and left variants.
- Railing Connector: A fence block that seamlessly connects the front of a railing to a fence.
- Banister: A wooden or brick girder block which can be used to decorate fences and railings.
- Window: A block similar to a door which can be opened and closed. Comes in all wood types, iron, copper, and silver.
- Beam: A wooden or brick pole block which can be placed in any orientation.
- Cross: Appears as two beams crossing; can be used as an intersection or corner.
- Black Petals: Another plant with the same format as Pink Petals and Purple Petals. Found in Blossom Caves
- Blossomlight: A unique plant found in Blossom Caves, which emits a light level of 12 and is used to brew the Potion of Luck
- Magma Cream Block: Crafted from 9 Magma Cream, used to brew the Potion of Eruption
- Redstone Lantern: A red lantern, crafted using a Redstone Torch
- Brick, Resin Brick, and Red Nether Brick fences
- Chiselled Bricks and Red Nether Bricks
- Cut Copper and Silver Walls
# Redstone components
- Comparer: This block has 2 faces on opposite sides. If the blocks in front of both faces match, block and state, it emits a signal of 15. (Currently this block also emits the signal from its faces, which may cause some unwanted behavior. This should be resolved eventually)
- Breaker: This block will mine the block in front of its face when powered, and the block's regular loot will be dropped. It can break any block instantly, except unbreakable blocks like bedrock.
- Detector: This block will constantly emit a signal of 15 if there is any block other than air in front of its face. It will turn off if the block is removed.
- Placer: This block has 1 slot of inventory, and if the item placed in it can be placed as a block, it will place it in front of its face when powered. For blocks with directions, the direction it's placed is based on the direction of the Placer.
# Structures
- Stables: A small abandoned village-like structure found in Badlands biomes. It has multiple different houses and other structures which it can generate, containing various loot.
- Nether Base: A small house found in the Nether, containing some workstations and materials.
- Lighthouse: Found in Beach biomes and contains loot.
Tomb: A small structure found in Cemetery biomes, and acts as a new grave variant.
# Block families
- Six new wood types: Grape, Joshua, Sequoia, Blue Oak, Caveblossom, and Gleam.
- A new mineral, Silver, which has many variants and uses.
# Biomes
## Overworld
- Grape Savanna: A warm, unique biome. Generates with purple Grape Blossom trees, which come in regular and huge sizes and give access to their own wood type. The Purple Petals flower can also be found here.
- Joshua Desert: A rare hot and dry biome with sharp and spiky Joshua trees, which give access to another new wood type.
- Cemetery: A rare grey biome with graves scattered around. No animals spawn here, and at night, only zombies and skeletons spawn here in increased numbers.
- Sequoia Forest: A unique forest with tall Sequoia trees, which give access to their wood type.
- Frosty Fields: A cold, snowy biome where you can find the Blue Oak trees and wood type.
- Blossom Caves: A cave biome where black plants grow. Here you can find Caveblossom trees and their wood type, Black Petals, and Blossomlights.
## Nether
- Glimmering Caverns: A quiet, green biome where only Striders can spawn. The Gleam wood type can be found here.
# Potions
- Potion of Bad Luck: Brewed by adding a Fermented Spider Eye to a Potion of Luck.
- Potion of Eruption: Gives the Erupting effect; causes three magma cubes of random size to spawn upon the entity's death, similar to Oozing.
# Music Discs
- "Conga Forest" by TDX; found in Jungle Temple chests
- "Desolate Area" by TDX; found in Desert Temple chests
# Advancements
- "What's The Rarest..."
- "Wood You Look At That!"
- "Definitely Very Healthy!"
- "Careful Bone Retrieval"
- "Certified Buzzplorer"
- "The Complete Discography"
- "Destruction of Property"
- "Kinda Sus"
- "Darken Down"
# Recipe tweaks and more
- Luck potions are brewable in Survival, using the Blossomlight.
- Backported from 26.1; Name tags are craftable using a piece of paper and any metal nugget
- Magma blocks are now crafted using a lava bucket and 4 cobblestone
